### Added
- **Marketing-contact bloat (licensing/cost signal).** A new `scanners/marketing.py`
  counts marketable contacts (`hs_marketable_status = "true"`) and the idle slice
  pushing the portal into a higher marketing-contacts tier. Engagement is measured
  from **opens OR clicks** (`hs_email_last_open_date` / `hs_email_last_click_date`):
  opens are MPP-noisy, clicks survive MPP, so a contact is idle only when neither
  fired. Never-engaged = both properties absent (`NOT_HAS_PROPERTY`); engaged-long-ago
  = had engagement but none within the staleness window (derived as
  `total − never − recently`, where recently-engaged is an OR of `GTE`-cutoff
  groups). `cost.compute_marketing_cost` turns that into a €/year saving. Read-only
  and count-only (shared `scanners.count_search` helper), degrades to a missing-scope
  callout on a 403. The seat-audit report (markdown + HTML) gains a
  **Marketing-contact bloat** section and `scan` prints a one-line summary.
  - **Two valuation modes.** HubSpot sells marketing contacts as *committed tiers*,
    not metered usage, so with the invoice in hand a `[<portal>.marketing_pricing]`
    table (`included` / `purchased` / `monthly_eur`) drives a **purchased-vs-used**
    saving — the reclaimable capacity (slack already over-bought + the idle contacts
    a cleanup frees) valued at the contract's effective per-contact rate, mirroring
    the seat audit's unused-seat logic. Without the invoice, a rough per-edition EUR
    block estimate (`cost._MARKETING_CONTACT_PRICING_EUR`) is the fallback; a non-EUR
    currency or unmodelled tier degrades to **flag-only** (counts, no €).
  - A `marketable-contacts` probe verifies the filters on a live portal.
